criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: 01 clone-army cover reads but the hero is matte clay under near-frontal light. 02 encoding reads with type covered, but specks on a black void, Waymo column off the left edge. 03 dead black band, unlit bottom fifth, long leaders. 04 lone lit flank works but empty bays don't read as bays, accent stripe on an accent-none frame. 05 real relief but one mid-grey band, flat orange groove, stair-stepped cast. 06 flat cutout skyline, stray sphere, navy cars, packed lot. 07 clean scale but staged in a void, blank street blades. 08 weakest: mannequin, wheel in front of nobody, black windshield, grey dash slab, stray vertical line. 09 strong close but hair shards and flat self-lit stripe.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One filmstrip: motif evolves across 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 and 9; one accent; dark values; value cut on 5 declared. 8's grey cab sits outside; cover lit near frontally; casts toward camera on 6; paint navy on 6 and 9.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and derived figures check; primary sources; rejected list honoured. One looser join: slide 8 puts between Dallas and Houston inside the observer sentence from c63.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Decision maker, rule and list named; concrete stakes; action with the exact route on 9; caption asks lawmakers. No deadline exists in the record.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, 2 pays at once, turns at 5 and 6, close on an action. 3 and 4 both work the tail; 4 could be cut.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and precise, house rules held. Method-note lines on 4 and 2 and caption line 11.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Subject diverges from 72 to 74, but repeats 74's staged lastLight world, opening move and night close; no. 52's white robotaxi on a dark lot; no. 67's ranks.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild frame 8 so the seated person's hands rest on a wheel in front of them with the road and seam through the windshield, and redraw frame 6's foreground as the thinning tail rows in limestone under the declared key.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Mannequin with bowed head, wheel in front of nobody, black windshield, grey dash slab, stray vertical line, cab edges behind the type.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Passenger-seat three-quarter with the rim in front of the figure, windshield as the light source with road and seam, dash in shadow, delete the stray line.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Packed navy lot instead of tail rows, flat cutout skyline with a stray sphere, casts toward camera, empty bottom third.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Foreground the last tail rows from FIG.units in limestone under the -55 key, skyline seated in haze, remove the sphere.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Dead band under the dek, unlit near-black bottom fifth, leaders up to 700 px, dividers as stray slabs.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower the camera target so far rows start under the dek, crop or light the near rows, labels within 60 px of their runs, dividers as lit end lines.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Plate one mid-grey band, gold groove a flat bar, stair-stepped cast.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Smooth the cast, rake the key lower so bevel and groove walls catch a bright edge, cut the gold as a recessed channel.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Hero is matte clay with cube sensors under near-frontal light, no bright edge, no seam.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Swing the key to azimuth -55 elevation 10 so the flank rakes, clearcoat, warm seam low left.
